records.source_statement: Subsection compares which partner is 'more noble'.
limitations: Seventeenth-century status claim, not contemporary worth.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord in an angle and ascendant lord in succedent is read as woman higher-status; reverse favours man.
Lilly also compares essential dignity and angular strength when judging relative status.
Another subsection asks which spouse will be 'master'.
limitations: Historical power language, not moral recommendation.

records.source_statement: Moon/first lord received at an angle by weighty planet influences author's mastery/subject role inference.
limitations: Continues onto p309, requires reception, not generic angularity.
